capabilities: bookmark any text selection from the command palette or right-click menu
jump back to a bookmarked selection, matching nearest occurrence if edited
filter bookmarks by title, text, file name, and group
organize bookmarks into one level of collapsible groups
highlight bookmarked text in the editor and reading view
extras: Desktop only; all data is stored locally in the plugin's data.json with no network requests.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in bookmarks mark whole files, headings, or blocks. This plugin bookmarks any part of a note
problem: Obsidian's core bookmarks can only mark whole files, headings, or blocks, not a sentence or a few paragraphs inside a note.
summary: Text-selection bookmarking tool that highlights selections in notes and jumps back to them from a searchable sidebar panel.
